verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no screen reader and no explicit accessibility features or settings for first-time setup. The only adjacent assistive tools are AI dictation via Voxtype, which must be installed first and is triggered by F9 or Super+Ctrl+X, plus OCR text extraction with Super+Ctrl+PrtScr; neither is framed as an accessibility feature. Missing for 10: a built-in screen reader, accessibility settings (magnification, high contrast, text scaling), accessible installer onboarding, and any independent corroboration that the system is usable by people with disabilities.
